concerns.text: Plan Phase 2 mandates a stratified-GroupKFold that 'enforce[s] that the distribution of composition one-hot categories is balanced across folds (stratified-GroupKFold) to reduce residual confounding'. No task implements fold stratification — T004/T005 use plain GroupKFold on source_id. This plan element has no covering task; either add a task or the plan must be revised.

Plan Phases 0 and 6 require VIF to be computed 'for each engineered interaction term (diagnostic only)' and to 'Re-compute VIF including interaction terms'. T019 computes base-predictor VIF only and explicitly states 'No VIF is computed for interaction columns'. The plan's interaction-VIF diagnostic element is uncovered by any task (note: spec FR-006 excludes interactions, so the plan itself is likely the stale artifact — reconcile).

Plan Phase 1 requires each interaction column to be 'orthogonalized (residualized) against its constituent main-effect columns'. T003 deliberately drops residualization ('No residualization') with documented rationale in the revision notes, but the plan element remains with no covering task and the plan was never updated — the mismatch should be reconciled in one of the two artifacts.
